people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: He burned Yahweh’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.
translations.bsb: He burned down the house of the LORD, the royal palace, and all the houses of Jerusalem—every significant building.
translations.kjv: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
translations.asv: and he burned the house of Jehovah, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burned he with fire.
